title: OpenAI Expands ChatGPT Work for Desktop Productivity
summary: OpenAI updated the ChatGPT desktop application to introduce a global context switcher and expanded ChatGPT Voice capabilities in the Work workspace.
content:
OpenAI released an update for the ChatGPT desktop application on macOS and Windows. The release introduces a dedicated Work workspace for professional tasks.

Users can toggle instantly between personal chats and workplace environments. The app maintains distinct context boundaries and memory stores for each workspace.

Enhanced Voice and Desktop Integration

The update brings ChatGPT Voice into the desktop Work mode. Users can dictate code changes, query documents, and trigger desktop shortcuts hands-free.

The application connects directly with local developer tools and text editors. It reads open files without manual copying and pasting.

Dedicated workspace modes prevent context mixing and keep professional workflows organized.

Security and Privacy Controls

Enterprise administrators can set policies for the Work workspace. Data created inside the Work mode complies with corporate retention policies.

OpenAI rolled out the desktop update to all Plus, Team, and Enterprise subscribers today.

Contributor: Alessandro Linzi
